title: 1.1 Titlekarte Tee
description: Drop: Normformate. Edition of 20. Released Tuesday 13.12.22. Orange screened tag. Front: Two color screen print, custom mixed blue, slight puff black. Normformate custom lettering by Todd Rupp. Font used is Lostgun by Qatatype. Back: Oversize 19" screen print, black ink. A-size paper format logo used and created by Walter Porstmann in 1922.

title: 1.2 Titlekarte Tee
description: Drop: Athletik. Edition of 20. Released Sunday 16.3.23. Dark purple screened tag. Front: Two color DTG print. Discus thrower from a Soviet era olympic postcard also featuring the roof netting of the Olympiastadion in Munich built for the 1972 Olympics. Font used is David by Emilie Rigaud and published through A is for -- Fonts. Also used; Pixelator by Evlogiev Studio.

title: 2.1 Notgeld Tee
description: Drop: Normformate. Edition of 20. Released Tuesday 13.12.22. Orange screened tag. Front: One color, double flashed, left chest, custom mixed tan. Scharfes S by Todd Rupp, font used Ekeras W01 Regular by Type Innovations. Back: Three color 18" back print, custom blue and tan with black ink. Double flashed tan and blue for lasting print. Notgeld design created November 14, 1921 for the town of Papenburg. There is an almost identical 75 note. Original German statement translated as: 'The money must taken from the people, you can't shake it from the trees.'

title: 2.2 Notgeld Tee
description: Drop: Athletik. Edition of 20. Released Sunday 16.3.23. Dark purple screened tag. Front: One color screen print left chest. Font used is Cool Font by Hvnter. Back: Two color oversize 18" print, custom gold Wilflex ink from the early 00's. Double flashed gold. Notgeld design created for the 'Berliner Sport-Club' in 1922. These notes, often referred to as Bausteine (or 'brick'), represent a donation to help build a Sportplatz for the Berliner Sport-Club, which still exists today under the same name.

title: 3.1 Grossfassung Hoodie
description: Drop: Normformate. Edition of 7. Released Tuesday 13.12.22. Sewn in screened tags on saved fabric. Front: One color embroidered left chest, 10,237 stitches. Right sleeve embroidered logo, 3,135 stitches. Back: One color oversize 20" back print, custom tan ink. Scharfes S designed and drawn by Todd Rupp.

title: 3.2 Grossfassung Hoodie
description: Drop: Athletik. Edition is ongoing. Released Sunday 16.3.23. Sewn in screened tags on saved fabric. Front: Three color embroidered center chest ~30 x 25cm. 69,253 total stitches. Font used is David by Emilie Rigaud and published through A is for -- Fonts. Also used; Pixelator by Evlogiev Studio. Crest logo borrowed from TSV 1860 Munchen. Design taken from a postage stamp for the 72 Munich Olympics. Colorways may vary.

title: 4.1 Logo Sweats
description: Drop: Normformate. Edition of 10. Released Tuesday 13.12.22. Sewn in screened tags on saved fabric. Hidden inner zipper pocket. Front: One color embroidered left thigh, 3,135 stitches. One color embroidered right thigh, 6,551 stitches. Font used is Lostgun by Qatatype.

title: 4.2 Logo Sweats
description: Drop: Athletik. Edition is ongoing. Released Sunday 16.3.23. Sewn in screened tags on saved fabric. Hidden inner zipper pocket. Front: One color embroidered center, 28,202 stitches. Font used is David by Emilie Rigaud and published through 'A is for -- Fonts'. Also used; Pixelator by Evlogiev Studio.

title: 5.1 Logo Kappe
description: Drop: Normformate. Edition of 12. Released Tuesday 13.12.22. Unconstructed six panel cotton loop-back, flat brim hat. Sewn in screened tags on saved canvas. Front: One color embroidered panel, 4,920 stitches. One color embroidered back panel, 3,135 stitches. Normformate custom lettering by Todd Rupp. Font used is Lostgun by Qatatype.

title: 6.1 Tschuss Kappe
description: Drop: Normformate. Edition is ongoing. Released Tuesday 13.12.22. Curved brim unconstructed 6 panel. Embroidered front. Fabric tightening strap with brass loop enclosure. Colorways: Navy (Ocean), Brown (Earth), Light Blue (Sky). Front: One color embroidery, 3,135 stitches. Font used is Lostgun by Qatatype.

title: 7.1 Recycelt Tee
description: First edition of the Recycled Tee. Edition of 12, 6 Medium sand colored long sleeves and 6 XL carolina blue ringer tees with sapphire blue collar and sleeve rings. Ten tees are numbered with roman numerals on the left sleeve, two say 'official sample'. One color print on left chest front, the tombstone text of Diana Abnoba the Queen of the Black Forest, two color screen printed back featuring the earliest known depiction of her existence, a statue held at the State Museum of Baden in Karlsruhe.

title: 8.1 die Versammlung: House of Otto
description: First edition of the archive of history. Edition of 18, 6 large long sleeve, 6 L short sleeve, 6 XL long sleeve shirts. Front: Two color screen print of the four horsemen of David as depicted in the Codex Egberti first printed in 980 AD. Back: Two color over size screen print of the family tree of Otto I first of the Ottonian Dynasty of German monarchs under the Roman Empire starting in 919 AD. Sleeve: Two color print of Lazarus being risen from the dead also depicted in the Codex Egberti.

title: 9.1 die Uberall
description: First edition of the 'Over-All' specialty tee. Edition of 24. Front: Ivory tees, Jade and Aquamarine ink on cardboard, rolled over several times to create a print effect. Ran through the roll dryer 6 times. Four print locations, jade ink background to match, orange puff logo. 24 tees took around 6 hours. Screen printed tags, sealed with a thumb print for authenticity.

title: Promotional Totes
description: Four screens, large 1-833-TSCHUSS letters, candy heart 'txt me', the silhouette of the man on the phone, and Calvin peeing on the number. Between summer of 2023 and current day, around 275 free tote bags have been passed out at events and out of the trunk of my car. Blue, green, orange letters first edition, candy heart pink on black second edition, Calvin third edition, silhouette green/red/navy junk ink and pink candy heart on canvas fourth edition.

title: Promotional Tees
description: Between summer 2023 and present day around 200/300 tees were given out at popups, events, and out of the trunk of my car. Tees were mailed across the country to just about anyone I came in contact with. Every size type, sleeve length, brand, color, and design that's been used in the process has been printed at random and distributed.
